title: This subscription is the best!
text: We are 4 months in I think and we have loved every single one. Our whole family can participate. We signed up for the 8-13 year old subscription and both my 5 and 11 year old love all their toys. I love that all the toys we receive are well over the price of the subscription so it’s a great deal. I also love that the toys are random and not always something we would choose ourselves so that has been a bonus. The variety has been great too. Totally worth signing up!
label: positive
